verdict.summary: The round-two diff remains correct and complete. Both added tests are non-vacuous soundness guards: the inverse-functional-property test distinguishes unequal objects and checks that neither the unavailable contrapositive nor prp-ifp produces unsupported differentFrom/sameAs conclusions, while the reflexive-property test includes a real rdfs:subPropertyOf positive control before checking that the RL-excluded reflexivity rule produces neither self-loops nor a false irreflexivity inconsistency. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is apparent. This is materially unchanged from round 1, which also found no issues, so progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
